purpose: Prevent implementation defects, invalid source backtests, and pre-strategy failures from being treated as alpha evidence; retain only correctly executed account results for logic decisions.

classification_contract.IMPLEMENTATION_INVALID: The intended causal strategy did not execute, or the source performance used future information, invalid accounting, or incompatible mechanics. Economic results are unusable.
classification_contract.IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED: The run stopped before any valid strategy/account evaluation. No logic inference is allowed.
classification_contract.MIXED_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_LOGIC: An implementation defect exists, but a sufficiently large set of valid accepted trades independently establishes the logic verdict.
classification_contract.LOGIC_FAILURE: The intended system executed causally with valid data, costs, fills, risk sizing, and continuous-account constraints, but cost-after expectancy or untouched replication failed.
classification_contract.LOGIC_OPPORTUNITY_FAILURE: Exact public branches were proven reachable under synthetic contracts, but the frozen source rules produced no usable opportunities in the current universe.
classification_contract.LOGIC_INSUFFICIENT: Execution was valid and some positive expectancy appeared, but growth, frequency, stability, or untouched evidence was insufficient for the project target.
classification_contract.PROVISIONAL_ALPHA: Valid development evidence is positive, but untouched evidence has not completed; it cannot be integrated or promoted yet.
classification_contract.PARITY_UNRESOLVED: A translation or source-equivalence gap remains; neither rejection nor promotion is allowed.

controller_rules: Never classify a pre-strategy exception as a losing strategy.
Never use an external performance report with lookahead, invalid risk, or incompatible multi-position mechanics as alpha evidence.
A zero-trade result is a logic opportunity failure only after exact branch reachability and source parity are independently proven.
If a defect is corrected, discard every result produced before the correction and rerun frozen rules.
Minor execution defects may coexist with a logic verdict only when valid accepted trades alone make the verdict overwhelming; such results remain ineligible for promotion.
Outcome-predictive recorder features are not account-policy evidence until an intervention is rerun in one continuous account.
Only a cost-after Nautilus continuous-account result can satisfy the project gate.
